prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Baytown, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1326; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: This is the adjuster speaking. The recording is on. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just give you the facts, if that's alright. I'm not comfortable saying my name on a recording yet.

Q: That's fine, we can note that you declined. Can you tell me where the accident happened?

A: It was on the highway in Baytown, Texas, in the right lane near the exit ramp. I was trying to move over to get off at the next exit.

Q: What time of day was it, and what were the road conditions?

A: It was afternoon. It was dry, and traffic was moderate, not stopped or anything.

Q: Walk me through what happened when you changed lanes.

A: I checked my mirror and glanced over my shoulder, and I didn't see anyone right beside me. I started to move over, and then a car came up on my left and clipped the side of my vehicle. It scraped along my passenger side and pushed me toward the shoulder.

Q: Did you have your turn signal on before you moved?

A: Yes, I'd had it on for a few seconds before I started to drift over.

Q: Did the other driver stop?

A: They slowed down, then kept going for a bit before pulling onto the shoulder. We exchanged information there.

Q: Were you injured?

A: Yes. I hit my right knee on the door frame when the impact happened. It's swollen and painful, and I've had trouble bending it since. I went to get it checked out the same day.

Q: Did you receive any treatment or seek medical care?

A: I was seen at an urgent care clinic, and they took X-rays and told me to follow up with a specialist. I'm scheduled to see one next week.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add about the accident?

A: Only that I was being careful and signaled before I moved. I just want my vehicle repaired and my knee looked after.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement. The recording is now off.
